summary: The recorded base reproduces the reported gated NVFP4 MoE post-load assertion with Gemma-4 TP=2 dimensions. The exact candidate passes that regression and independent padding/layout checks, including GPU-resident tensors on gfx950. The patch is recommended for acceptance, but the original two-B300 TP=2 server/model contract remains locally unverified because the required NVIDIA architecture, second GPU, and model weights are unavailable.

tests.revision: 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365 with only the candidate regression test materialized
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before execution through the real process_weights_after_loading method; observed the reported (1, 2816, 22) warning and original gated-padding assertion.
Candidate regression plus adjacent ModelOpt NVFP4 MoE scale coverage: 17 tests and 38 subtests passed.

Independent tensor oracle across nine aligned/padded intermediate sizes, two experts, gate/up marker separation, zero padding, w2 and scale correspondence, no-op identity, malformed-layout rejection, and the 352-channel case on gfx950.

gpu_execution.evidence: The independent 352-channel tensor padding oracle ran on AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2 and produced w13=(2,768,16), scales=(2,768,2), w2=(2,32,192), and w2 scales=(2,32,24). This does not exercise NVIDIA FlashInfer CUTLASS kernels.

remaining_counterexamples: No tensor-level counterexample was observed; the original two-rank NVIDIA B300 server load and serving path remains unexecuted in this environment.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 GPU was assigned; the report requires two NVIDIA B300 GPUs.
The nvidia/Gemma-4-26B-A4B-NVFP4 weights were unavailable, so full model loading, generation, and TP=1 versus TP=2 semantic parity were not tested.
The real CUDA/FlashInfer CUTLASS swizzle and MoE execution kernels cannot run on this ROCm host; the focused regression uses a contract-faithful swizzle test double.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
